about_the_game:
BOUNCE ADVENTURE is a vibrant 2D pixel-style action platform game  where you control a lively, elastic ball and dive into the whimsical world of Toy City. Navigate through finely crafted levels, dodge deadly traps, solve clever puzzles, and take on a fast-paced, fun-filled adventure packed with challenges!

                                                            Features:

  • Genre: 2D Side-Scrolling Action / Platformer / Pixel Art.

  • Standalone levels and endless challenge modes — enjoy nonstop bouncing fun.

  • Clear level faster, collect more rings — earn greater achievements.

  • Dynamic traps and smart enemies — test both your reflexes and strategic thinking.

  • Tight physics and responsive controls — delivering a smooth and satisfying bouncing experience.

  • Planned Features: Level editor & online multiplayer — create your own maps, invite friends to take on your challenges, and explore a community-driven world of creativity.

  • Developer: Solo indie developer.

Are you ready to jump into this bouncy world? Let's bounce, adventurer!
